thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a staggered-ramp traffic replay tonight to validate the new KV-cache warmup and reduce p95 spikes. Target window 00:30-03:00 UTC. Need confirmation on infra and who can own profiling hooks. (cc @jay @priya)

jay: I can take infra. Do we need extra executor instances or just tweak autoscale? Also what's the replay source? S3 or mirrored topic?

maria: Using the replay blob in s3://replays/prod-traffic/2026-03-16-partitioned/ — it's pre-sampled. Prefer to keep autoscale off for determinism, we'll reserve 20 vcpu workers and 40 runtime instances. Nate — can you reserve dedicated nodes?

nate: Yep, reserving nodes now. Will spin up a dedicated pool (r5-like) and pin to the night cluster. ETA ~20m.

priya: I'll own the Locust side. Plan is staggered ramp: 0 -> 500 users over 30m, hold 60m, step down. We'll replay user pacing preserved from trace. Any custom headers to inject?

maria: Add header `X-Replay-Source: prod-2026-03-16` and `X-Trace-Tag: nightly-replay-v3`. Also enable `cache-warm=true` query param so runtime exercises prefix caching.

oliver: Quick config question — do we run with model fallback enabled? Last time fallback masked a regression.

maria: Disable automatic fallback for the main run. We'll do a short canary with fallback on after the main run finishes.

priya: k6/locust cmd I'll use (small snippet):
```
LOCUST_MASTER=10.2.3.5 locust -f replayer.py --headless -u 500 -r 16 --run-time 1h30m --host=https://api.redwood.example
```
I'll also push a replay config to `infra/replays/nightly-v3.json` — Jay, please review the routing rules.

jay: Reviewing now. A couple notes: set `max-inflight-requests: 64` and `batching.enabled: false` for the run. Also add tracing flags so we can correlate traces: `--trace=nightly-replay-v3` in the worker env.

ci-bot: Job queued: replay-reservation-1767800123 (owner: priya). [link]

priya: Got the reservation. I'll start a dry-run at 23:40 UTC to validate headers and log ship.

maria: For profiling: capture perf flame (async-cpu), CPU allocation profiles every 15s, and JS heap snapshot at T+45m. Tag artifacts with `nightly-replay-v3` and upload to `s3://redwood-perf/nightly-replays/1767800123/`.

nate: Node reservation done. Also enabling `io_priority: high` for those machines.

oliver: I'll watch p95/p99, error-rate, kv cache hit ratio, and eviction rate. If p95 > 220ms or error rate > 0.5% hit the abort flag.

maria: Abort criteria noted. If abort triggers, we'll collect `/var/log/redwood/runtime/last-5m.log` and snapshot KV metadata.

jay: One more — ensure quota limits for test accounts are bumped so throttling doesn't interfere. I'll patch the quota controller.

priya: Dry-run successful. Sample logs look good. Starting main run at 00:33 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary started (replay-canary-v3) — 10 users, fallback enabled.

priya: Main run started. first 10m looks clean. P95 ~ 110ms, errors <0.1% :thumbsup: 

oliver: Seeing a small p95 blip at T+22m, digging into traces now. Possible tail GC on runtime-12.

maria: Take runtime-12 out of pool and re-run rotation. Nate, can you ssh to that node and pull heap profile?

nate: SSHed and pulled heap/profile. Uploading to s3 now: s3://redwood-perf/nightly-replays/1767800123/runtime-12-heap.pb

oliver: Heap looks OK, but there's a KV cache thrash pattern. Lowering cache eviction threshold and rewarming prefixes.

priya: Hold window complete. Starting step-down.

maria: Great work. After-action: please add brief notes to the runbook with the KV-thrash mitigation steps and the rotation we used. I'll open a quick PR to update `runbooks/replays.md`.

jay: Done — PR #412 merged with rotation cmds and quotas adjustments.

priya: Uploading summary metrics and dashboards link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/xyz/nightly-replay-1767800123

maria: Thanks team. Next steps: schedule a follow-up to evaluate cache tuning and decide if we should roll changes to prod. Meeting Friday 10am PT. :calendar:

oliver: +1

nate: +1

priya: +1
